limitations: The uploaded FirstGame.zip predates the latest Codex changes. Current local project must be inspected at import.
The three hero designs and all sixteen monster concepts are provided, but generated animation poses are reinterpretations, not pixel-identical to original artwork.
Hero fall, dive, death and several repeated frames are provisional. Monster movement, attack, hurt and death sequences are provisional and not directional.
Attack combo variants and individual spell effects in the live project are not exhaustively covered. Keep existing assets for these until dedicated animations exist.
Frame geometry and RGBA checked; no GameMaker runtime import or gameplay test performed.
